integrity: The argument is an exact algebraic proof from finite-support invariance and irrational coefficient comparison; it uses no numerical evidence as proof and does not claim independence from prior literature beyond the documented searches and comparisons.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to common invariant probabilities with support cardinality at most two.
The bases are distinct, beta is irrational, and (gamma-1)/(beta-1) is a positive rational number.
No claim is made for supports of cardinality at least three or for nonatomic singular common invariant measures on the excluded relation.
title: Two-point common invariant measures on the excluded beta line are fixed-point mixtures
